paths.path: Configuration directory selected by the -Dkernal64.config Java property; otherwise the application config location

paths.path: Kernal64 configuration and Joystick settings UI
paths.naming: Joystick port 1/2 uses keyboard keypad or JInput USB joystick; no portable text binding grammar is documented

paths.path: Inside mounted C64/C128 disk/tape/cartridge media; emulator save RAM is media-defined
paths.naming: PRG/D64/G64/TAP/CRT media and emulated REU/cartridge files retain their source filenames; no universal sidecar save extension

paths.path: User-selected Save state file from the State menu
paths.naming: Java serialized state stream; filename is user-selected and no fixed extension is mandated by the README

Required/optional machine ROMs include basic.rom, kernal.rom, chargen.rom, c1541.rom; C128 roms/128/{basic.rom,kernal.rom,characters.rom}; JiffyDOS filenames are JiffyDOS_*.rom/bin. No canonical checksums are published
